text:
Hi there, and thank you for contacting Leafy! I'm so sorry your bird of paradise is struggling. Losing that many leaves is worrying, especially when you've followed the care card closely.

**Good news: this may be covered by our Plant Care Guarantee.**

Losing more than a third of its leaves counts as significant decline. Every live plant has a 30-day guarantee from delivery (90 days for Leafy Plus members). Since you're about 3 weeks in, you should still be within the window, but I'd file soon to be safe.

**How to make a claim:**
- Go to "My Orders" and start a Plant Care Guarantee claim.
- Upload at least two photos: one of the whole plant and one close-up of the affected leaves or stems.
- A Plant Care Specialist will review your claim within 2 business days.
- You don't need to send the plant back.

If approved, we send one free replacement of the same plant, or store credit if it's out of stock. I can't promise approval, as the specialist makes that decision after reviewing your photos.

**A few things the specialist may check:**
- Whether the plant was repotted into non-Leafy soil in the first 14 days (this isn't covered)
- Whether pests appeared after delivery
- Whether a weather hold was waived and the damage came from cold or heat in transit

If none of those apply, you should be in good shape.

**Care advice in the meantime:** our Plant Care Specialists are happy to help anyone with free advice by chat (9am-5pm, Mon-Fri, your local time) or email at help@leafy.example. It's also worth checking the soil. Most early problems come from overwatering, so water only when the top inch of soil is dry.

Is there anything else I can help with? Please reach out any time, and I hope your plant bounces back soon! 🌿
